structural_defect.name: inside_spread_selection_without_admission_floor_fallback
structural_defect.description: The V7 event-time core selected an improved quote when total fill-conditioned EV increased, then applied configured min-edge/min-fill admission only after the selection. An inside quote could therefore be selected and later SKIP even when the original touch quote remained admissible, creating an avoidable paper zero-fill.
structural_defect.fix: Patch the V7 maker adapter so inside-spread improvement must itself pass the configured conditional post-cost edge floor, fill-probability floor and positive EV before replacing the touch quote. Otherwise retain the touch quote and let normal admission evaluate it.

next_required_evidence: chronological V7 paper A/B on identical public data: old selector vs configured-floor fallback
actual FIFO paper fills and audited realized post-cost PnL
strict depth-aware 45s/60s/300s markouts with bounded observation delay
inside-spread improvement only when fill-conditioned EV beats touch after toxicity, fees, slippage, cancel latency and unwind risk
